faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Technical Support III.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 26 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs 28000 per month (consolidated, excluding HRA) plus HRA 30% per month (+Rs 8400), if applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters degree in Computational biology/Bioinformatics; experience in programming language and data analytic; experience in analysis of single-cell RNASeq data; experience >1 year.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian Nationals only.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not Indian Nationals.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test. Skill test.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure 1 year, can be extended for further period subject to review. Appointment is purely temporary with no right to claim any regular appointment in the University.
